scripts.text:
DELETE FROM EDS.BOB_PAYROLLDTL WHERE AS_OF_DATE = (SELECT TOP 1 CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) FROM D360.STG_EDS_BOB_PAYROLLDTL);

INSERT INTO EDS.BOB_PAYROLLDTL
(
    AS_OF_DATE
    ,ACCT_NO_DEST
    ,AMOUNT
    ,BATCH_PROC
    ,CLIENT_REFNO
    ,CORP_ID
    ,CREATE_DT
    ,DEL
    ,DEST_ACCT_TYPE
    ,DEST_CURR_CD
    ,EMPLOYEE_EMAIL
    ,EMPLOYEE_FIRST_NAME
    ,EMPLOYEE_LAST_NAME
    ,EMPLOYEE_MIDDLE_NAME
    ,ERROR_MSG
    ,HDR_ID
    ,ID
    ,IDS_REF_NO
    ,IS_GENERATED
    ,MOBILE_NO
    ,POSTING_DT
    ,RECORD_ID
    ,REF_NO
    ,STATUS
    ,TXN_DT
    ,UPDATE_DT
    ,VERSION
    ,isActive
    ,isLatest
    ,BNK_CODE
    ,SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,insert_dttm
)

SELECT 
CONVERT(DATE,LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME, 12), 8)) AS AS_OF_DATE
    ,ACCT_NO_DEST
    ,AMOUNT
    ,BATCH_PROC
    ,CLIENT_REFNO
    ,CORP_ID
    ,CREATE_DT
    ,DEL
    ,DEST_ACCT_TYPE
    ,DEST_CURR_CD
    ,EMPLOYEE_EMAIL
    ,EMPLOYEE_FIRST_NAME
    ,EMPLOYEE_LAST_NAME
    ,EMPLOYEE_MIDDLE_NAME
    ,ERROR_MSG
    ,HDR_ID
    ,ID
    ,IDS_REF_NO
    ,IS_GENERATED
    ,MOBILE_NO
    ,POSTING_DT
    ,RECORD_ID
    ,REF_NO
    ,STATUS
    ,TXN_DT
    ,UPDATE_DT
    ,VERSION
    ,1 as isActive
    ,1 as isLatest
    ,left(FILE_NAME, 5) as BNK_CODE
    ,substring(FILE_NAME,7,3) as SOURCE_CODE
    ,FILE_NAME
    ,convert(datetime2,insert_dttm) as insert_dttm
FROM D360.STG_EDS_BOB_PAYROLLDTL
WHERE H = 'D'
